UltimateProfileAvatar.UseLibravatar_Desc1: Load avatar from Libravatar using SHA-256 hash from these sources in order
UltimateProfileAvatar.UseLibravatar_Desc3: automatically calculated from an existing user id (must be an e-mail)
UltimateProfileAvatar.UseLibravatar_Desc4: Secure CDN is used. Gravatar is a default fallback.
UltimateProfileAvatar.DiceBearFallback_Desc:
Load deterministic avatar from DiceBear if Libravatar option is disabled, no valid hash was found or no such e-mail exists on Libravatar and Gravatar (default fallback).
Disable this option to pass avatar handling to other plugins like ProfileAvatar.
UltimateProfileAvatar.DiceBearCustomURL_Desc:
Get it on DiceBear Playground from HTTP-API, remove seed parameter from URL.
Defaults to animated Voxel Art style if empty.
UltimateProfileAvatar.ShowInVisitsLog_Desc: Insert avatar below browser, device, OS and other icons.
